posts.subject: m_yaw
posts.bodyHtml: So guys, I heard from some guy on the knife server that said there's some sort of exploit that can help you knife longer or something? Apparently this m_yaw command (e.g. m_yaw 0.022 is the normal one I think) and increasing or decreasing this can increase the amount of pixels you can actually reach to. Maybe you guys could experiment on this and maybe ban it or something if it's really influential? Just wondering ='D

Placebo effect.
What m_yaw does, is change the horizontal sensitivity of your mouse. Reducing it from for example 0.022 to 0.0165 changes your mouse horizontal sensitivity, some people do it because they play at stretched resolutions (4:3) and they feel that their horizontal acceleration / sensitivity is too high.


However, it does not make you knife farther or do basically anything noticable to other people.
m_yaw doesn't rly change the knife range but you can use cl_armlength '1.1' that gives you 10% more range.
xD what about if you do cl_armlength 2 xD, will that give you 100% more range?
